verdict.rationale: The axis applies because vLLM is a model-serving engine with an OpenAI-compatible API, so aliasing a loaded model under a custom name is a fair question. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a way to assign a custom identifier or served name to a loaded model. The OpenAI-compatible server, multi-LoRA, and CLI items describe adjacent features and do not show model aliasing.

support.subject: As a developer, I can assign a custom identifier to a loaded model for consistent reference in API calls
